comments.text: The people here are tougher than most of us can imagine.

comments.author: @DiscoveringTheWorld6868
comments.text: In Indonesia, approximately 15 million people live directly within the danger zones of around 127 active volcanoes. Despite facing significant natural disaster risks, they choose to remain for various practical reasons tied to their livelihoods, economic well-being, and ancestral roots.

comments.author: @Top10Documentary999
comments.text: Indonesia is truly fascinating! 🇮🇩 I was especially amazed by the stories of the sea nomads and the unique communities living among the islands. It really shows how differently people can adapt to nature and create a life in places most of us could hardly imagine. Watching this made me want to visit Indonesia and experience its culture firsthand. 🌴🌊
